LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No.: KDS/DOL/4/4/5/3/3.

Land Ministry Reference No.: 4/3/9/2012/WS/227. I, hereby give notice under Sub - section (i) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be acquired:

Two allotments of land called “Ambagasthenna alias Liyowatta alias Oruwaketutennehena” in total extent of about 0.0136 Hectares, depicted as Lot No. 176& 178 in the Cadastral Map No. 320026, Block No. 01 of Block 01 and Sheet No. 6, surveyed and prepared by the Surveyor General on 27.02.2015, situated at the village of Medapitiya in Medapitiya Grama Niladhari Division, No. 1155 in the Divisional Secretary.’s Division of Doluwa in Kandy District, Central Province and bounded as follows:—
